questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: The University of Edinburgh regnes for et af de bedste universiteter i verden. På flere ranglister over de bedste universiteter i verden er det ofte placeret i top tyve. Jeg mente, det ville sjovt at studere på et sådant universitet og sammenligne, hvad det gør ift. KU.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Jeg havde allerede foretaget en del research, inden jeg tog afsted. Det er dog ikke alle informationer omkring universitetet og ens bolig, som man automatisk får at vide (hvis man bor i boliger ejet af universitetet selv), men man kan altid spørge universitets administration om hjælp.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Når man ankommer, skal man hente nøgler til sin bolig, og dér var folkene bag skranken meget hjælpsomme, hvis man havde spørgsmål. De lod til at være trænet i at hjælpe nye studerende.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: On campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Universitet har masser af boliger, så det var ikke et problem at få tildelt et værelse - også selvom værelset selv ikke var min førsteprioritet.

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: I nogle af universitets bygninger skal man selv sørge for mad, men i den bygning jeg boede i, var der en kantine, hvor morgen- og aftensmad var inkluderet i husleje. Der var også et lille køkken med køleskab, mikrobølgeovn og elkeddel. Uanset hvad skal man være opmærksom på, at universitets køkkener ikke inkluderer køkkenudstyr, og at man selv skal anskaffe sig dette.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Det er fint.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Der er meget rigt om de få kurser der er til udvekslingsstuderende. Det gik dog i længden.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: At skrive til administrationen om hjælp.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: 2/3 kurser var nogle jeg havde ønsket inden da.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Start i god tid.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Undervisningen var generelt god, og underviserne var mere engageret end dem på KU. Der blev også krævet en del af de studerende. Det blev ofte forventet, at man bidrog til undervisningen.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: UoE havde mere engagerende undervisning end KU.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

Additional comments:
questions.answer: Der er masser af studenterforeninger som specialiserer sig i hver sit område. Der er noget for enhver smag.

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Masser forskelligt.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Whiskyforeningen fordi man jo er i Skotland. Ellers er ølforeningen god.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Udforsker byen og ellers andre dele af Skotland.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Meget nemt. Skottere er meget ligesom danskere om end venligere og mere høflige.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Meld dig ind i en studenterforening.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Ikke rigtig nogen. Udover at man ikke kunne sige "fuck" og "shit" hele tiden.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: At folk var meget venlige og høflige (selvom høfligheden sommetider kunne virke kunstig og falsk)

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Ved jeg ikke.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Ved jeg ikke.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Få noget perspektiv på livet derhjemme. Og så også at kunne sige til sig selv at man har været på udveksling og boet i et andet land.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: At planlægge ind- og udrejsen.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
